Hello Jarosław,

The power supply in the Magic Miner 40T is built in and rated at 1,400 W, about 94 percent efficient, with a 100 to 240 V 50/60 Hz input on an IEC C14 socket. So there is plenty of headroom over the roughly 650 W the unit draws at 40 TH/s in Standard mode, and over the 850 W figure you mention for Turbo. Worth noting that Turbo is an overclock and it voids the warranty.

The exact PSU module number and a photo of its specification label are not something I have in front of me, so I have passed that to JD on our hardware side. He picks it up today from 10am Eastern and the answer comes back to you in this thread.

If you would like it faster, JD is very active on our Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf. Post in the server and mention @nullhashrate, he is shown there as JD with the Admin role.

Your order is unchanged, still shipping 30 November 2026.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
